Triage — first-touch grading (concentrated round, triage seat, session `session_0138jAR5jeREBpm4dhVvbWY7`): **`needs-user-decision` + `domain:devx`.** This is ADR-class and sits on the manual floor: the load-bearing rule "server enforces, client is courtesy" is cited ~20× as `ADR-0057 D10`, but no D10 in either ADR-0057 document says that — fixing it properly may require *recording the decision in an ADR*, which only the maintainer can author.

Four-facet block:
1. **Platform long-term coherence**: a rule this load-bearing must anchor to a real recorded decision; every round it stays unanchored, more citations copy it (objectui has inherited it twice already).
2. **Measured business pull**: real — a reader following the anchor today lands on the Setup-nav decision, concluding either the code or their search is wrong; the filer hit this from live objectui implementation work.
3. **AI-agent error-resistance**: agents copy citations verbatim; an unresolvable anchor propagates structurally. Option 3 (teach `check-adr-anchors` to verify the `Dk` exists in the cited ADR) makes the whole failure family unrepresentable — #8386 was the same family.
4. **Startup scope discipline**: options 1+3 are bounded (one anchor relocation sweep + one gate rule); option 4 (do nothing) compounds.

**Recommendation**: confirm where "server enforces, client is courtesy" was actually decided — if nowhere, authorize one new D-line in `0057-erp-authorization-core-business-units-and-scope-depth.md` (or wherever you prefer it recorded) — then split: card A relocates the 20 citations + anchor `adrs` disambiguation (mechanical once the target exists), card B lands the gate rule (option 3, expect a first-run red batch to sweep). The only input needed from you is the anchor's true home; everything after is dispatchable.

Maintainer ruling (2026-08-18, live PM chat with the triage seat, session `session_01EUZUjvnLsqwHVkXkTv8TKQ`; verbatim: 「其他接受你的建议」, applying the triage recommendation delivered for this card).

**Ruled: remedies 1 + 3, split into two cards.**
1. **This card (remedy 1)**: give "server enforces, client is courtesy" a real anchor — add a new decision entry to the ERP-authorization ADR-0057 (`0057-erp-authorization-core-business-units-and-scope-depth.md`), next free number (D13 by the card's reading), whose text is the standing rule, marked as a retroactive recording of an already-practised decision. Then retarget all ~20 citations + the `adr-anchors/` invariant to the new resolvable anchor, and disambiguate the anchor's bare `ADR-0057` per #5992. ⚠️ The PR touches `docs/adr/**` ⇒ governed face: draft only, human merge, never armed/queued.
2. **Remedy 3 (gate deepening — `check-adr-anchors` validating that a cited `Dk` is a real heading of the cited ADR) is a separate follow-up card**, blocked on this one landing (so the gate doesn't go red on the known-bad citations it exists to catch). Filed as a sibling; see cross-link.

Returned to `pm:queue`, stays `domain:devx`. Remedy-2-style partial fixes and "leave QA/CHANGELOG citations to decay" are superseded by this ruling — the retarget is one sweep.

## PM: landed — closing this card

The work merged and the card was left open because **the PR carried no `Fixes` / `Closes` keyword**, so nothing auto-closed it. That is a half-state on my side, not an unfinished task: it has been sitting `pm:dispatched` with the work already on `main`.

- **PR #9655** — merged `2026-08-18T15:17:17Z`
- Verified from this seat by re-reading the merged PR rather than from my dispatch record.

Closing as completed, and dropping `pm:dispatched`.

**Root cause, so it stops recurring:** my landing check asked *"did a PR merge?"* per card, but nothing asked *"is any card still `pm:dispatched` whose PR already merged?"* — the reverse direction. The repo's own half-state patrol covers this class; I was not reading it per round. Same shape as the two proxy-signal errors earlier today: **I was checking a thing that correlates with the answer instead of the answer.**
